The run proved nothing.\033[0m"; else PYTHONPATH=. python -m mutmut results > .reports/mutation_survivors.txt 2>&1; S=$(grep -c ': survived' .reports/mutation_survivors.txt); echo -e "\033[1;32m✔  Mutation Check: complete — $S survivor(s), see .reports/mutation_survivors.txt\033[0m"; fi
tasks.label: Tests: Mutation Check
tasks.detail: Mutates the modules listed in .validate/mutmut_modules.txt and reports which mutations no test detected. On demand only — not part of Validate All. Survivors need judging: some are real gaps, some change nothing. NEVER delete mutants/ — it is the cache AND the results store, and changing the module list does not require it.

tasks.detail: Reads the test suite, not the code. REACH: every declared health finding and repair key must be produced by a test that drives a real poll, not by calling the check with a hand-built snapshot. tasks.label: Mock: Fault Drill
tasks.detail: Automated. Arms each mock Supervisor fault, drives real scans through the integration's own scan_now action, and asserts Integration Health and Repairs over the HA APIs. Paced by HA's 10-second refresh debounce, so a full run takes a few minutes. Clears the fault however it exits. Not part of Validate All. Writes .reports/fault_drill.txt as well as the screen.

tasks.command: mkdir -p .reports && { [ -f .devcontainer/fault_drill.py ] || { echo -e "\033[1;36m–  Skipped: no .devcontainer/fault_drill.py in this project\033[0m"; exit 0; }; S=.notes/fault_drill_last.txt; W="custom_components/*/health.py custom_components/*/coordinator.py custom_components/*/const.py custom_components/*/strings.json custom_components/*/translations .devcontainer/mock_supervisor.py"; C=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- $W 2>/dev/null); D=$(git status --porcelain -- $W 2>/dev/null); M=""; if [ ! -f "$S" ]; then M="never run"; else L=$(cut -d" " -f1 "$S"); H=$(cut -d" " -f2 "$S"); if [ -n "$C" ] && [ "$C" -gt "$L" ]; then M="stale - last run $H, and a watched file has changed since"; elif [ -n "$D" ]; then M="uncommitted changes to a watched file since the last drill ($H)"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$M" ]; then printf "\033[1;33m✖  Fault Drill: %s. Run the 'Mock: Fault Drill' task.\033[0m\n" "$M"; else printf "\033[1;32m✔  Fault Drill: PASSED\033[0m\n"; fi; } 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g' > .reports/fault_drill_staleness.txt; exit 0
tasks.label: Mock: Fault Drill Staleness
tasks.detail: Prints NOTHING when the drill is current, and nothing at all in a project without a fault drill - so when it does speak, it means something. Warns only if the drill has never run, or a file that could invalidate it has changed since. Never fails the build.
